geronimo-specs is not there on Fedora sources.
Finding it's upstream source from "http://geronimo.apache.org" is also not straightforward.
It appears to be a package defined by Microsoft itself.
The tar.gz is supposed to be created using the SVN tags mentioned in the spec file itself.
https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/geronimo/specs/tags/
That is why update may not be required.
However, we did find a source repo for this on github:
https://github.com/apache/geronimo-specs.git
From there we can see that newer versions of some sub-packages are available.
But we are not sure whether and how those should be used and whether old ones should also continue to be a part of the source tar.gz.
